calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS first_period, 8 AS last_period
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS cc_net,
       SUM(l.net_sales) AS web_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 2) AS share
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2;

SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) - count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31') AS dup_sales_ids,
 (SELECT count(*) - count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31') AS dup_receipt_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) - count(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-12-21') AS dup_return_ids,
 (SELECT count(*) - count(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM fact_web_order) AS dup_orders,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id<>900) AS web_lines_not_900,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE s.store_id<>900) AS web_returns_not_900,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.receipt_id NOT IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order)) AS lines900_no_order,
 (SELECT round(sum(net_sales),2) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=900 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-12-21') AS control_total,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected') AND dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL) AS no_dispatch;

WITH d AS (
 SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids, min(channel_code) cc, min(store_key) sk, min(sale_date) sd, min(net_amount) mn, max(net_amount) mx, min(etl_loaded_at) e1, max(etl_loaded_at) e2
 FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
 GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE store_key=sk) sid, count(*) groups, sum(n) rows_, sum(CASE WHEN mn=mx THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) same_amount, min(sd), max(sd), min(e1), max(e2)
FROM d GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10;
